reviews.text: I first enrolled my dog ​​in this kindergarten for training for about a year when it first opened, and now I use their services when I travel! They have a 24-hour manned supervision system, and they let my dog ​​interact with other kindergarteners during the day and even take him for walks, which gives me great peace of mind. While I'm traveling, they send me lots of photos and videos, and even tell me about his day and how many times he went to the bathroom, so I feel completely at ease leaving him in their care. They also plan several field trips throughout the year, which is a great bonus as it allows me to easily take my dog ​​out with me.

My child started attending in May, when they turned one, and it's been over three months now. They love the teachers and friends, and are always thrilled to go to kindergarten.

We receive many photos and detailed reports about their day via LINE, which we share with the family and it gives us peace of mind.

I'm so glad we enrolled them! I highly recommend this kindergarten to anyone considering it.

This is a place where you can leave your dog with peace of mind 😊
It hasn't been long since he started attending, but I'm already very satisfied 🙆‍♀️
They send detailed reports and lots of photos via LINE every time, so I've come to look forward to that too 🧡
He looks so happy and laughing, and I always smile when I see the pictures 🤭
I thought he was silly, but he's able to do the training I taught him at home, which is amazing!
I'm so grateful to the instructors 🙏
The fact that the other dogs are so gentle is another reassuring point! 🧡
He gets to play a lot at kindergarten, so when he comes home, he sleeps soundly without the barking habit that was my biggest problem 😹
I enrolled him so that he could be looked after without stress, and it's been successful, and both my dog ​​and I are happy!
We will continue to send him here in the future 🐶✨️

We always look forward to using your services, both for our dogs and ourselves. The trainers are kind, and they carefully explain how our dog did at the daycare during drop-off and pick-up, and they also send updates via LINE, so we feel completely at ease leaving our dog in their care!

My dog ​​started kindergarten this spring! There are dogs of all different breeds, and I'm so happy to see the teachers sending me pictures and updates about her day, showing how much fun she's having. 🐩
She goes four times a month, and on the days she goes, when I ask, "Do you want to go to kindergarten?", she wags her tail excitedly and gets ready to put on her leash. Once we arrive, she's so happy she completely ignores me and greets the other dogs and teachers. ❤️ When we get home, she's exhausted from playing and is in relaxation mode. 😊 This month is her first swimming lesson, so she's really looking forward to it! 🐩

My child is enjoying attending classes and making new friends.

They are able to concentrate well on training that is difficult to do at home.

I'm really looking forward to their future progress!

We have been sending our two Miniature Dachshunds, ages 1 and 4, to this daycare since December of last year. The staff are all very kind, and both dogs enjoy going there. They send us lots of photos and videos of their time there, which I look forward to seeing. It has only been about two months since they started attending, but thanks to the training, they are gradually becoming well-behaved, and I can see them growing every day. Previously, we had a one-on-one trainer, but it was too strict and stressful for them. Here, the trainers teach at the dogs' own pace, so they seem to be enjoying learning. I am glad we chose this place.

Although my child only attends about once a week, we can clearly see their daily growth!

They happily show off everything from basic training to tricks at home 😂

I always look forward to the photos, videos, training content, and daily updates after they arrive 😌🤲

There are plenty of events, including field trips and swimming in the summer, and I trust the teachers!

It's been two years since we started going.
We started going for training purposes, specifically to address barking habits.
After a while of going, when I told him the day before, "Tomorrow's kindergarten!", he'd be super excited (lol).
When I drove him there, he'd be super excited just getting to the road near the kindergarten (lol).
It's clear he's having a lot of fun ♡
I can really see from the photos you send that you're showering him with love.
Thank you so much as always!!!

My dog ​​is a Jack Russell Terrier, a breed that can be quite quirky, but he gets along wonderfully with many other dogs and I think it's an ideal place for him to develop social skills.

Also, I'm very happy that they send me lots of photos and videos of the dogs at the daycare via LINE, allowing me to get a glimpse into their lives.
